review.tagline: MCP server that lets AI clients control the Unity Editor
review.summary: A Unity package plus a Python MCP server that exposes 50 tool entrypoints for creating scenes and GameObjects, editing C# scripts, managing assets, running tests, profiling and building. It works with any MCP client, including Claude Desktop and Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline and Gemini CLI. Installed through Unity Package Manager from a git URL or OpenUPM.
review.audience: Unity developers who want an AI assistant to drive the Editor through MCP
strengths: Covers scenes, scripts, assets, tests, profiling and builds in 50 tool entrypoints
Works with any MCP client; one menu action configures detected clients
MIT licensed; docs cover multi-instance routing, tool groups and remote server auth
weaknesses: Requires Python 3.10+ via uv alongside the Unity install
Only targets the Unity Editor; no runtime or other engine support
Install tracks the main branch by default unless a version tag is pinned
Sponsored by a vendor that also sells a premium assistant, Aura for Unity
needs: Needs Unity 2021.3 LTS to 6.x, Python 3.10+, uv
Models: Any MCP client (Claude, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline, Gemini CLI)
